Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You smother the flame, bind the cut or steady your breath, attending to the hurt before it worsens.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self or one adjacent creature
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Universal

With a plausible method, reduce Bleeding, Burning, or Freezing by 1. This is not a general cure for all conditions. A persistent source can require a specific remedy.
